name: Quietforge Docs API
description: Pay-per-call document conversion, PDF text extraction, headless-browser rendering of a URL or HTML to PNG / JPEG / PDF, a health-probed directory of x402 pay-per-call endpoints, a sudoku generator (solver-verified, technique-graded puzzles as JSON or a print-ready A4/Letter book), a book typesetter (prose manuscript to a KDP-ready interior PDF + editable docx), a crossword generator (verified freeform grid from your clue/answer pairs as JSON or print-ready PDFs), a family tree chart layout engine (descendant / ancestor / hourglass charts from people+families JSON or a GEDCOM file, as verified layout JSON or print-ready poster and tiled PDFs), and a dataset quality audit tool (duplicates, missing values, type consistency, class imbalance, numeric outliers and PII-pattern counts for a CSV/JSON dataset, as JSON or a one-page PDF summary). Payment: x402 (USDC on Base). No signup, no API key.
terms: Submit only files you have the right to process. Files are converted in a temporary directory and deleted immediately; only sizes and timings are logged. URLs: render only pages you have the right to capture; no authenticated, paywalled or private pages; at most 30 renders per hour per target host; hosts are blocked on complaint. x402 index: Listing data aggregated from the public Coinbase CDP bazaar and PayAI discovery APIs; probes are ours. Quietforge operates the index and is itself listed in it (source: quietforge), under the same per-host cap as every other operator; rows are ordered by 30-day usage, then liveness, then freshness, never by operator. Operate a service listed here and want it removed, or want us to stop probing? Email quietforgestudio@agentmail.to and we delist within one crawl. Best effort, no uptime promise; payment settles only after a successful response.

resources.description: Detect the structure of a book manuscript before typesetting it: the chapter list our engine will use (numbered / unnumbered), words and scene breaks per chapter, paragraph count, characters the book font cannot print, and the warnings a full build would raise. Same parser as /v1/typeset, so what you see here is exactly how the book will be divided.

body.manuscript:
Chapter One

The lamp on the landing had burned all night, and by morning the hallway smelled faintly of paraffin and toast. Nora stood at the window with her coat already on, counting the carts that passed the gate. Six, then seven. The eighth was late, and she knew before it turned the corner that it would be empty.

* * *

Her brother came down at nine, still buttoning his cuffs, and asked whether the letter had arrived. It had not. She said so without turning round, and he took his tea to the study and shut the door.

Chapter Two

The letter came on Thursday, folded twice, and told them nothing they had not guessed. The field was sold. The buyer would take possession at Michaelmas, and the tenants could stay until then on the old terms. Nora read it aloud at the table, slowly, and when she finished nobody spoke for a long time.

manuscript.description: The whole manuscript as plain text or markdown. Chapters: 'Chapter N', 'CHAPTER N', '# Title', a roman numeral line ('IV.') or a bare Prologue/Epilogue line; scene breaks: '* * *' or '#'; *italic* and **bold**; one blank line between paragraphs (hard-wrapped lines are joined).

warnings: Very short chapters (<150 words): (untitled), (untitled) — check they are real chapters.

metadata.doNotUseWhen: The manuscript has images, footnotes, tables, verse with fixed line breaks, lists or non-Latin scripts, or you need a cover, an EPUB, or editing of the text.

resources.description: Typeset a prose manuscript into a print-ready book interior: zip (base64) with the interior PDF at your trim (5x8, 5.25x8, 5.5x8.5, 6x9, A5), mirrored margins, KDP-minimum gutter, running heads, page numbers, recto chapter starts, front matter, contents, justified Crimson Text; an editable .docx twin; LAYOUT-REPORT.md. Text is never rewritten. Prose only: no images, footnotes, tables, verse, lists or non-Latin text. Flat price; 120-word minimum.

Row content and matched PII are never returned. Data is held only for the request, then deleted, not logged. Submit only data you may lawfully process; triage, not a compliance service.
